reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 12 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/moustache crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-02 restores the source near-frontal pose with a slight turn toward image right and a forward gaze rather than the prior conspicuous left turn. The light grey-khaki cap retains a dark visor, pale piping/cord and silver-white front eagle. Dark eyebrows remain, and the face has one small dark upper-lip moustache with a smooth clean-shaven chin and no beard or glasses. One stern closed mouth, khaki-olive uniform, pale metallic collar/shoulder details and a short broad fitted collar remain. The prior top clip and third lower note row are removed: the note now has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row and largely blank lower paper, plus the original right-edge tab. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque pale warm grey-beige backing remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Cap-eagle feather detail, tiny collar/shoulder symbols, the precise moustache edge and note lettering are not reliably readable at source scale. These fine uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the restored pose, upper-lip-only facial hair, absent clip and two-by-two note layout are directly visible.
